name: The Other End
source:
A university student begins volunteering at an emotional-support hotline. Among the many calls she takes, one caller keeps coming back, and each time he introduces himself under a different name. As his calls grow more personal, she starts to wonder how much he already knows about her, and who is really on the other end of the line.

[From [url=https://marigoldpetals.itch.io/the-other-end]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一名女大学生开始在心理援助热线做志愿者。在她接听的众多来电中，有一个男人总是反复打来，而且每次都会报上不同的名字。随着他的谈话内容越来越涉及私密，她开始怀疑对方究竟已经掌握了自己多少底细，而电话那头坐着的又到底是谁。

[摘自[url=https://marigoldpetals.itch.io/the-other-end]itch.io[/url]]
